ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Local Email Collection
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may target user email on local systems to collect sensitive information.
Files containing email data can be acquired from a users local system, such as Outlook storage or cache files.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-Inbox\\\.ps1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.Office\\\.Interop\\\.Outlook.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.Office\\\.Interop\\\.Outlook\\\.olDefaultFolders.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-comobject\\ outlook\\\.application.*"))
